soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, nasus reddish brown, antennae, mouthparts and tarsi the same colour as the head, thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellowish white, the anterior half of the pronotum slightly darker. The posterior part of the top of the head with a pair of long hairs, the tip of the nasus with four longer hairs and fine short hairs, and several hairs near the base of the nasus; the hairs of the thorax and abdomen fine and short. Head elongate, the lateral margins slightly constricted behind the antennal sockets and then widened again, the posterior margin without a median notch, pear-shaped in dorsal view; nasus rather short, almost in a straight line with the top of the head; mandibles without a spine; antennae with 13 segments, the second and third nearly equal in length and longer than the fourth. Pronotum saddle-shaped, about half as wide as the head, the anterior margin upturned and slightly concave in the middle, the posterior margin almost straight.
